summary: Enhance your financial acumen with our Hedge Funds and Private Equity Fundamentals Training Course. Gain essential skills and insights for investment success.
lede: Private equity and hedge fund training gives finance professionals a practical foundation for assessing alternative funds and supporting fund operations. Learners examine hedge fund strategies and performance, build leveraged buyout models, assess valuation and liquidity risks, conduct operational due diligence, prepare investor reports, and track private equity deals from sourcing through exit.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for finance professionals who require a technical and operational understanding of the alternative investment ecosystem to enhance fund performance and compliance.
audience: Hedge Fund Analysts focused on alpha generation
modules: Alternative Investment Foundations and Market Structure
Hedge Fund Strategies and Alpha Generation
Private Equity Lifecycle and LBO Modeling
Risk Management and Operational Due Diligence
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate finance and financial statement analysis. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required for modeling exercises. Prior exposure to traditional asset management or investment banking is recommended but not mandatory.
